title: Sliding Window & Two Pointers
description: Master the linear-scan patterns that turn O(n²) brute force into O(n) solutions.
longDescription: Sliding window and two-pointer techniques are the highest-value patterns in coding interviews because they convert naive nested loops into a single pass. This module covers fixed-size windows, variable-size windows with a shrink condition, same-direction and opposite-direction pointers, and the fast/slow pointer pattern for linked structures. Each problem includes a brute-force baseline so you can see exactly what the optimized approach removes.
whatYouLearn: When a sliding window beats a brute-force nested loop
How to prove a window only needs to move forward
The fast/slow pointer pattern for cycle and midpoint problems
